subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don't find any error, mark 'No error' as your answer.

If the players don't wear sunscreen, / their faces will / get reddest.

options.text: If the players don't wear sunscreen,

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1: get reddest**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error is in the phrase "**get reddest**." The superlative form "reddest" is incorrect in this context, as it compares the redness of the face among multiple people. Instead, the comparative form "redder" should be used to indicate that one face will be more red than another.

 
 
• **Correct phrase:** "get redder"
 
 
 
• **"Redder"** is the correct comparative form, used when comparing two or more things, in this case, faces, to indicate a greater degree of redness.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1: get reddest**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *If the players don't wear sunscreen, their faces will get redder__.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "their faces will"** (no error): This part is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "No error"** (incorrect): This option is incorrect because the phrase "get reddest" is a grammatical error and needs to be corrected to "get redder."
 
• **Option 4: "If the players don't wear sunscreen,"** (no error): This part is correct as it sets the conditional statement properly.
